blocks.text: Aya magambo akoreshwa kimwe mubikoresho byitangazamakuru byagatatu bikoreshwa mukwerekana, imikoranire cyangwa imitako kurubuga rwa OmniCivitas hamwe nububiko bwa kode ya GitHub, harimo amashusho, amarangamutima, GIF, amashusho, amashusho yerekana amashusho, umuziki, ingaruka zijwi, amajwi nibindi bijyanye no gutunganya ibya kabiri.

Uburenganzira, uburenganzira bwikirango, uburenganzira bwabahanzi, uburenganzira bwabatunganya amajwi na videwo bigira uruhare mubikoresho byavuzwe haruguru, hamwe nifoto, izina, ijwi nubundi burenganzira hamwe ninyungu zemewe n amategeko, ni abafite uburenganzira bwabo. Uyu mushinga ntubona uburenganzira kubikoresho byumwimerere kubera gukusanya, kwerekana, kwikuramo, guhinga, guhindura ijambo cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gutunganya; uburenganzira bushya bwongeweho bwashyizweho hakurikijwe amategeko murwego rwa kabiri rwo gutunganya ntibusimbuza uburenganzira bwibikoresho byumwimerere.

Ibikoresho bimwe biva mugihe kirekire cyo gukwirakwiza imiyoboro, kandi uwabitangaje mbere, umwanditsi, uwatunganije cyangwa urwego rwuzuye rwa nyirubwite ntashobora kwemezwa neza. Uyu mushinga ntusaba ibintu bituruka nkumwimerere, byemewe, cyangwa murwego rusange. Kuba ibikoresho bikwirakwizwa cyane, bifite imyanzuro mike, kandi byabyaye inshuro nyinshi ntabwo bivuze ko uburenganzira bujyanye nabwo bwarangiye.

Uyu mushinga nigeragezwa ryikoranabuhanga ridaharanira inyungu no kwerekana imyidagaduro. Kugaragara kw'ibikoresho ntibisobanura ko abafite uburenganzira bireba, amasosiyete, imirimo, ibirango cyangwa inyuguti mu bikoresho bitabira, kwemeza, gutera inkunga cyangwa gutera inkunga uyu mushinga, nta nubwo bivuze ko uyu mushinga ufite umubano w’ubufatanye na bo. Intego yo gukoresha urwenya, gutunganya kabiri cyangwa intego zidaharanira inyungu ntabwo ubwabyo bivuze ko uruhushya rwabonetse cyangwa ko rwose rwubahiriza ibitemewe gukoreshwa mumategeko akurikizwa.

Imikoreshereze yimikoreshereze yinkomoko yinkomoko igengwa na LICENSE mububiko hamwe nuburenganzira bwa dosiye ihuye. Nubwo kodegisi yumushinga yonyine yemeye uruhushya rwa MIT, uruhushya ntiruhita rutwikira amashusho yundi muntu, INGABIRE, amajwi na videwo, ibimenyetso byerekana ibimenyetso cyangwa ibindi bikoresho byitangazamakuru. Igice cya gatatu kode igengwa nimpushya zabo.

Uyu mushinga ntabwo uha abakoresha uruhushya rwo kwigana, guhuza, gukwirakwiza cyangwa gucuruza ibikoresho byabandi bantu binyuze muri aya magambo. Iyo uruhushya rwihariye cyangwa uruhushya ruriho kubintu, urwo ruhushya cyangwa uruhushya rugenga; iyi mvugo ntabwo isimbuye, kwagura cyangwa kuyikuraho. Gufunga ububiko, gukuramo dosiye cyangwa gukoresha urubuga ntabwo bivuze ko wabonye uburenganzira bwo gukoresha ibikoresho byitangazamakuru.

Iyo ufite uburenganzira cyangwa intumwa yabiherewe uburenganzira yizeye ko ibikoresho biri muri uyu mushinga birimo uburenganzira n’inyungu ze, ashobora gutanga ibitekerezo abinyujije ku kibazo kiri mu bubiko bwa GitHub bw’uyu mushinga cyangwa abinyujije mu miyoboro y’itumanaho yatangajwe n’umuyobozi. Kugirango woroshye gushakisha no kugenzura, nyamuneka sobanura impapuro, dosiye cyangwa ibikoresho bijyanye, uburenganzira busabwa, uburenganzira bwo kugenzurwa cyangwa ishingiro ryibigo, nuburyo bwifuzwa bwo gutunganya.

Nyamuneka ntutange amakuru yihariye nkibyangombwa biranga, aderesi, numero ya terefone, nibindi mubibazo rusange; mugihe ukeneye gutanga icyemezo kitari rusange, nyamuneka banza usabe umuzamu gutanga umuyoboro wihariye. Uyu mushinga ntuzanga kugenzura ibirego bifatika bishingiye ku "kuzenguruka kuri interineti" cyangwa aya magambo, kandi bizafata icyemezo cyo guhagarika kwerekana, gusimbuza, gusiba cyangwa izindi ngamba zikenewe zishingiye ku kugenzura no ku mategeko akurikizwa.

Aya magambo akoreshwa mugusobanura imipaka yuburenganzira nuburyo bwo gutanga ibitekerezo. Ntabwo ari inyandiko yemewe yabifitemo uburenganzira, ntanubwo ari icyemezo cyo gusonerwa uburyozwe bwemewe n'amategeko. Ababishinzwe bafite inshingano zijyanye no gukoresha, kwerekana no gukwirakwiza hakurikijwe amategeko; uburenganzira bwihariye ninshingano zimpande zombi bireba amategeko akurikizwa, impushya zemewe nibisabwa. Aya magambo ntabuza cyangwa abuza abafite uburenganzira gusaba uburenganzira bwabo hakurikijwe amategeko, nta nubwo gusiba, gusimburwa cyangwa kuvanwa mu bubiko bihita bivanaho inshingano zemewe n'amategeko zavutse.
